A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the form factors of the soliton-creating operator are given by the sum of the contributions from the soliton and the antisoliton sectors, and the normalization constants are the product of two factors.

the form factors for the soliton-creating (topologically charged) operators in the massive Thirming and sine-Gordon models are given by a product of a function of the rapidities of the particles, which is the same function as the corresponding form factor of a particle, and an additional function, which is a function of the difference of the rapidities.
the normalization constants of topologically charged operators are given by the product of the corresponding topological charges and the corresponding form factors of the identity operators.
